long_biography.plain_text:
Vincent Tan has directed much of his public philanthropy towards practical barriers facing lower-income Malaysians. Better Malaysia Foundation supports education, healthcare and housing, including free community learning centres and assistance for cancer treatment and haemodialysis services.

His housing work led to Yayasan My First Home, established to help young and first-time buyers who struggle to secure financing. The foundation brings developers, financiers, donors, charities and public agencies together around affordable home ownership. Tan has also funded other charitable work from his personal resources, developing Better Malaysia Foundation from the private donations with which he began.

uncertainties: The source record stores Tan as a middle name and Chee Yioun as a surname. Public naming conventions and the native name indicate that Tan is the family name and Chee Yioun the Chinese given name, but the database's handling of an adopted English name is unclear, so no name-field correction is proposed.

The strongest biographical sources give 23 February 1952 and Berjaya marks Founder's Day on 23 February. Some football databases instead display 3 March; this lower-quality conflict is disclosed while the day 23 is proposed at High confidence.

Forbes explicitly labels the fortune self-made, while independent profiles positively document the inability to fund university, early salaried work and gradual move into franchising and acquisitions. This supports the independent-start subtype, although complete family finances are not public.
The Berjaya portfolio spans many sectors and no single disclosed holding clearly dominates current private wealth; both industry classifications therefore remain Diversified.

Berjaya explicitly identifies several Twitter, TikTok and Instagram accounts as impostors. No verified personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, TikTok or personal website was found, so none is proposed.

Current and historical vessel relationships were used only as cohort and identity-disambiguation context. Neither biography contains vessel names, specifications or ownership history, and both pass the sale-independence test.
